title: API Documentation — sendletter
description: Send physical letters in Canada with one API call. Test keys, idempotency, delivery status, cancellation, webhooks and volume pricing from as low as $1.69 a letter.
text:
API Documentation — sendletter API Reference Send physical letters anywhere in Canada programmatically. One endpoint, three modes. Letters from as low as $1.69 all in (postage included) with automatic volume pricing , no monthly fee. Quick Start Send a letter in one API call. Start with a test key : it checks your request and prices the letter but mails and bills nothing, and it needs no card. Create an account at sendletter.app/signup Create a test key on Developers Send a POST request (below), then GET the letter and watch its status When it works, add a card and create a live key. Your first live letter is charged when you send it curl -X POST https://sendletter.app/api/v1/letters \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sl_test_YOUR_KEY" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "mode": "draft", "letter_size": "standard", "from": { "name": "Jane Smith", "line1": "123 Maple St", "city": "Toronto", "province": "ON", "postal_code": "M5V 2T6", "country": "CA" }, "to": { "name": "John Doe", "line1": "456 Oak Ave", "city": "Vancouver", "province": "BC", "postal_code": "V6B 1A1", "country": "CA" }, "letter": { "date": "2026-03-23", "salutation": "Dear John,", "body": "This is a test letter sent via the sendletter API.", "closing": "Sincerely,", "signature": "Jane Smith" } }' Authentication All requests require a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Authorization: Bearer sl_live_YOUR_API_KEY Live keys start with sl_live_ and mail and bill real letters. Test keys start with sl_test_ and never print, mail or bill (see Test mode ). You have at most one of each. Keep keys secret. If one is compromised, replace it on Developers ; the old key stops working immediately. A live key needs a valid payment method on file; without one requests return 402 . Test keys need no card. Every authenticated /api/v1 endpoint is limited to 120 requests a minute per key ( /api/v1/quote without a key and /api/v1/pricing are public and not limited this way). To send many letters, use the batch endpoint : a batch of up to 100 letters counts as one request. POST /api/v1/letters Creates a letter. It is queued for printing and mailed within 1 business day via Canada Post. POST /api/v1/send is the same endpoint under its original name and keeps working. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry cannot mail a second letter. Request Body Field Type Required Description mode string Yes "draft" , "formatted" , or "upload" letter_size string No "standard" (default), "large" , or "legal" : see Options colour boolean No Print in colour ( true , $0.50/page) or black and white (default false , $0.15/page). color is accepted too. duplex boolean No Print double-sided (default true ). Same price per page; uses fewer sheets and can lower postage. from object Yes Return address (see Addresses ) to object Yes Delivery address — must be in Canada letter object Draft only Letter content fields (see Draft mode) html string Formatted only HTML content for the letter body css string No Additional CSS (formatted mode only) file string Upload only Base64-encoded PDF or DOCX file_type string Upload only "pdf" or "docx" page_count number docx, formatted Number of pages, 1–200. Required for docx uploads (we can't paginate them). For PDFs and drafts we count the pages ourselves and ignore it. For formatted HTML, send it: otherwise we estimate. font string No Font family (see Options ) font_size number No Font size in pt (8–24, default 12) vertical_center boolean No Vertically center content on page reference string No Your own reference, up to 200 characters. Shown on invoices and in order history, and returned on every read and webhook. metadata object No Up to 20 string key/value pairs (keys 40 characters, values 500), returned on every read and webhook. Response The letter object, the same one every other endpoint and webhook returns. warnings appears only when something looks wrong but we did not refuse it, for example a postal code that belongs to another province. { "id": "uuid-of-letter", "object": "letter", "livemode": true, "status": "queued", "created_at": "2026-12-01T14:03:11.000Z", "printed_at": null, "mailed_at": null, "cancelled_at": null, "letter_size": "standard", "pages": 1, "mailings": 1, "stamps": 1, "colour": false, "duplex": true, "currency": "cad", "amount_cents": 248, "price": { "version": "2026-11-26", "lines": [ { "item": "base", "qty": 1, "unit_cents": 99, "total_cents": 99 }, { "item": "envelope", "qty": 1, "unit_cents": 10, "total_cents": 10 }, { "item": "pages", "qty": 1, "unit_cents": 15, "total_cents": 15 }, { "item": "postage", "qty": 1, "unit_cents": 124, "total_cents": 124 } ] }, "to": { "name": "John Doe", "line1": "456 Oak Ave", "city": "Vancouver", "province": "BC", "postal_code": "V6B 1A1", "country": "CA", "line2": null }, "from": { "name": "Jane Smith", "line1": "123 Maple St", "city": "Toronto", "province": "ON", "postal_code": "M5V 2T6", "country": "CA", "line2": null }, "reference": "INV-1042", "metadata": {} } Idempotency A letter is physical: a retry that is not recognised as a retry mails a second one, and a second one cannot be recalled. Send an Idempotency-Key header (1 to 255 printable characters, no spaces; a UUID is ideal) with every POST : Situation Result Same key, same request, already finished The original response again, with Idempotent-Replayed: true . No second letter, no second charge. Same key, same request, still running 409 request_in_progress . Retry shortly with the same key. Same key, different request 422 idempotency_key_reuse . A key means one request. The first attempt failed validation or payment The key is released: fix the request and retry with the same key. Keys are remembered for 7 days and are separate for test and live keys. JSON key order does not matter. Network errors, timeouts and 5xx responses are safe to retry with the same key; use backoff and honour Retry-After . Test mode A test key ( sl_test_ ) runs the whole path: validation, page counting, pricing (including your volume discount), the response, status, cancellation and webhooks. It never prints, mails or bills, writes no invoice, and needs no card. Test letters are only visible to test keys, and live letters only to live keys. Test letters move through their statuses on their own so you can build against them: queued , then printed after 30 seconds, then mailed after 2 minutes. A test letter fires letter.created when you send it, letter.printed and letter.mailed as it reaches those steps (when you next GET it, or within about five minutes, whichever is first), and letter.cancelled if you cancel it. Use POST /api/v1/webhooks/{id}/test to send a signed webhook.test event to an endpoint on demand. What test mode does not check: whether the street address exists. It does flag a postal code that belongs to another province. Status, history & cancellation Request What it does GET /api/v1/letters/{id} The letter, with its current status and price. GET /api/v1/letters Your letters, newest first. ?limit= (1–100, default 20) and ?starting_after= . Returns {object: "list", data, has_more} . POST /api/v1/letters/batch Send up to 100 letters in one request, counted as one request against your rate limit. See Rate limits & bulk sending . DELETE /api/v1/letters/{id} Cancel a letter that is still queued . Its billing is voided, or refunded if already paid. A printed letter cannot be recalled ( 409 not_cancellable ). Status Meaning queued Accepted and waiting to be printed. Can still be cancelled. printed Printed and being stamped. Can no longer be cancelled. mailed Handed to Canada Post. mailed_at is set. cancelled Cancelled before printing. Ordinary Lettermail has no delivery tracking: mailed is the last status we can know. You can see and export every letter, and your invoices, on Orders and Invoices . Webhooks Create endpoints on Developers or with POST /api/v1/webhooks ( { "url": "https://...", "events": ["letter.mailed"] } ; omit events for all). The signing secret is returned once. Events: letter.created, letter.printed, letter.mailed, letter.cancelled . A test key creates an endpoint that receives test letters. POST https://your-server.example/webhooks/sendletter Sendletter-Event: letter.mailed Sendletter-Signature: t=1764600000,v1=5257a869e7ecebeda32affa62cdca3fa51cad7e77a0e56ff536d0ce8e108d8bd Content-Type: application/json { "id": "evt-uuid", "object": "event", "type": "letter.mailed", "livemode": true, "created": 1764600000, "data": { "object": { ...the letter... } } } Verify the signature. Compute HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + raw_body) as hex and compare it, in constant time, with v1 . Reject timestamps more than 5 minutes old. import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto"; function verify(secret, header, rawBody) { const { t, v1 } = Object.fromEntries(header.split(",").map((p) => p.split("="))); if (Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - Number(t)) > 300) return false; const want = createHmac("sha256", secret).update(t + "." + rawBody).digest("hex"); return want.length === v1.length && timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(want), Buffer.from(v1)); } Answer with any 2xx within 10 seconds. Anything else is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h, 24 h ( 7 attempts in all). Endpoints must be https on a public address; redirects are not followed. Events can arrive more than once, and out of order, so use the letter's id and status rather than assuming sequence. Modes Draft Mode Provide structured letter fields. We render them into a properly formatted letter page. letter.* Type Required Description body string Yes Main letter text (max 50,000 chars). Whitespace is preserved. date string No Date line (top-right) salutation string No Greeting, e.g. "Dear John," subject string No Subject line (rendered as bold Re: ...) reference string No Reference number closing string No Sign-off, e.g. "Sincerely," signature string No Printed name below closing cc string No CC line enclosures string No Enclosures note ps string No Post-script (italic) Formatted Mode Send your own HTML content. We wrap it in a print-safe page template with proper dimensions (8.5×11" or 8.5×14" at 72dpi, 1" margins). Max 500 KB. { "mode": "formatted", "html": "

Hello World

Custom HTML letter content.

", "css": "h1 { color: navy; }", "font": "Georgia", "font_size": 14 } Upload Mode Upload a pre-formatted PDF or DOCX file as a base64 string. Max 40 MB, max 200 pages. A PDF is printed as sent and its page count is measured on our side. For a DOCX, send page_count . { "mode": "upload", "file": "JVBERi0xLjQK...", "file_type": "pdf", "page_count": 2 } Addresses Field Type Required Description name string Yes Full name (max 200 chars) line1 string Yes Street address (max 200 chars) line2 string No Apt, suite, unit (max 200 chars) city string Yes City (max 200 chars) province string CA/US Province or state code (required for CA and US) postal_code string CA/US Postal or ZIP code (required for CA and US) country string No 2-letter ISO code. Defaults to "CA" A return address that doesn't fit these fields can be sent as a few free-form lines instead: "from": { "lines": ["Ana García", "Calle 17 #4-77", "Bogotá D.C.", "Colombia"] } (up to 6 lines). Undeliverable mail can only be returned to an address in Canada. Important: The to address must be in Canada ( "country": "CA" ). The from (return) address can be in any country. The to postal code must be a full Canadian code ( K1A 0B1 , with or without the space): Canada Post charges an item with a missing or incorrect postal code at higher rates, so a partial code would leave the letter short on postage. A return address may be looser. A postal code whose first letter does not match the province (for example V6B with ON ) is accepted but returned as a warnings entry: this is a typo check, not address verification. Options Letter Sizes & Envelopes Value Paper Envelope One envelope carries Address standard 8.5 × 11 in, folded #10 window up to 11 pages double-sided Printed address page, shown through the window large 8.5 × 11 in, flat 9 × 12 mailer up to 168 pages Hand-addressed legal 8.5 × 14 in, flat 10 × 15 mailer up to 130 pages Hand-addressed A letter too long for its envelope is split across as few envelopes as needed (a flat mailer takes far more than a #10, so it is usually cheaper to choose one). Each envelope is a mailing with its own fee, envelope and stamps, and the response reports mailings . Fonts Available for draft and formatted modes: Times New Roman (default) Georgia Arial Helvetica Courier New Verdana Pricing All prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD), with no GST/HST charged on top. You pay for what a letter takes: total = (mailing fee + envelope) x mailings + pages x page rate + stamps x $1.24 Item Price Mailing fee (API), per mailing, list price $0.99 (falls to $0.20 with volume, see below) Printing, black and white, per page $0.15 Printing, colour, per page $0.50 Envelope: #10 window / 9×12 mailer / 10×15 mailer $0.10 / $0.25 / $0.40 Canada Post postage, per stamp (passed through at cost) $1.24 Pages are billed per printed page, whether or not you print double-sided. The address page of a window envelope is free. Postage is charged at cost: how many stamps a mailing needs depends on its weight and envelope under Canada Post's Lettermail rates (one stamp covers a #10 up to 5 double-sided pages; flat mailers are oversize and start at 3 stamps). Example Stamps Total 1 page, colour, #10 1 $2.83 1 page, black and white, #10 1 $2.48 6 pages, black and white, #10 2 $4.47 30 pages, black and white, 9×12 flat 4 $10.70 Volume pricing The more you mail, the less you pay, automatically. Only the mailing fee is discounted: postage stays at cost. It falls from $0.99 on your first letter to $0.20 on your 100 th mailing in any 30 days, and stays there while you keep sending. The count is a rolling 30 days, not a calendar month, so a steady sender stays at the lowest fee. Cancelled letters do not count. At the floor, a one-page black-and-white letter is $1.69 all in. Your mailing number (in 30 days) Mailing fee Discount 1 page, B&W, #10, all in 1 $0.99 0% $2.48 2 $0.87 12% $2.36 5 $0.71 28% $2.20 10 $0.60 39% $2.09 25 $0.44 56% $1.93 50 $0.32 68% $1.81 75 $0.25 75% $1.74 100 $0.20 80% $1.69 Every response shows how the fee was set ( price.volume ). GET /api/v1/pricing returns this table and, with ?letters_per_month=250&pages=1 , a worked estimate. There is a calculator on the volume pricing page . POST /api/v1/quote Price a letter without sending it. No API key needed (add one and the quote uses your real 30-day volume; without one, add letters_in_last_30_days to see a discounted price). Send pages (1– 200 ) and optionally letter_size , colour and duplex ; you get the same price breakdown that /api/v1/send returns. curl -X POST https://sendletter.app/api/v1/quote \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "pages": 6, "letter_size": "standard", "colour": false }' Error Codes Status code Meaning 400 invalid_request, invalid_address, unsupported_destination, invalid_body, invalid_cursor, invalid_volume, pricing_error, idempotency_key_required, invalid_batch, batch_too_large, invalid_json, invalid_letter_size, invalid_options, invalid_pages, invalid_reference, invalid_metadata, invalid_idempotency_key, invalid_webhook The request is wrong: missing or invalid fields, a non-Canadian delivery address, invalid postal code, content too large. 401 invalid_api_key Missing or invalid API key. 402 payment_method_required, payment_failed A live key with no card on file; or your first letter's up-front charge was declined (nothing was sent). 404 letter_not_found, webhook_not_found No such letter or endpoint for this key (test and live letters are separate). 409 request_in_progress, not_cancellable An identical request is still running; or the letter is already printed. 422 idempotency_key_reuse That Idempotency-Key was used with a different request. 429 rate_limited, daily_limit_exceeded Too many requests (see Retry-After ); or this letter would take today's spending over your daily limit. 500 internal_error, billing_record_failed Our fault. Nothing was sent or charged when it is billing_record_failed . Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key. support@sendletter.app 503 service_unavailable Temporarily unavailable. Retry after Retry-After with the same Idempotency-Key. Every error has a human-readable error and a stable code to branch on: { "error": "to.postal_code is not a valid Canadian postal code. Expected format: A1A 1A1", "code": "invalid_address" } Rate limits & bulk sending Each key may make 120 requests a minute (a sliding one-minute window; test and live keys have separate allowances). Every response says where you stand, and a request over the limit is refused, not queued: Header Meaning X-RateLimit-Limit Requests allowed per minute for this key (120). X-RateLimit-Remaining Requests left in the current window. Retry-After On a 429 rate_limited : the number of seconds to wait before trying again. Sending in bulk: use the batch endpoint POST /api/v1/letters/batch takes up to 100 letters in one request and counts as one request, so you can send thousands of letters without coming near the limit: 5,000 letters is 50 requests. Each letter is created exactly as it would be by POST /api/v1/letters (same validation, volume pricing, daily limit and webhooks), one after another, so letter 40 is priced after letters 1 to 39. curl -X POST https://sendletter.app/api/v1/letters/batch \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sl_live_YOUR_KEY" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: statements-2026-12-batch-0007" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "letters": [ { "mode": "draft", "reference": "stmt-1001", "from": { ... }, "to": { ... }, "letter": { "body": "..." } }, { "mode": "draft", "reference": "stmt-1002", "from": { ... }, "to": { ... }, "letter": { "body": "..." } } ] }' An Idempotency-Key (1 to 240 characters on a batch) is required . Letter i is created under the key ":" , so if a request times out or your process crashes you simply send the same batch with the same key : letters already created come back as replayed (no second letter, no second charge) and only the missing ones are created. The response is 200 with a result for every letter, in order: { "object": "batch", "total": 3, "created": 1, "replayed": 0, "failed": 2, "not_processed": 0, "results": [ { "index": 0, "status": "created", "letter": { "id": "...", "status": "queued", ... } }, { "index": 1, "status": "error", "http_status": 400, "code": "invalid_address", "error": "to.postal_code is not a valid Canadian postal code..." }, { "index": 2, "status": "error", "http_status": 429, "code": "daily_limit_exceeded", "error": "..." } ] } A letter that fails does not stop the others. Fix it and re-send the batch with the same key to create just that one. Once your daily spending limit is reached, the rest of the batch is refused at once with daily_limit_exceeded . If a batch runs long (about 45 seconds) the remaining letters come back as not_processed . Re-send the same batch to create them. Only whole-request problems return a non-200 status: a bad key ( 401 ), no card on a live key ( 402 ), bad JSON, no Idempotency-Key or more than 100 letters ( 400 ), the rate limit ( 429 ), or our database being unreachable ( 503 ). Staying under the limit Batch. One request for up to 100 letters is the single biggest saving. Send batches one after another, not in parallel, so volume pricing and the daily limit are applied in order. Use webhooks, not polling. Every status check is a request. Subscribe to letter.mailed instead of calling GET in a loop. Honour Retry-After . On a 429 rate_limited , wait that many seconds. If it is absent (a 503 , a network error), back off exponentially with jitter: 1 s, 2 s, 4 s, 8 s, up to about a minute. Reuse the same Idempotency-Key on every retry of the same request. Retrying with a new key is how a duplicate letter is made. Do not retry a 429 daily_limit_exceeded until tomorrow (Toronto time) or until you raise your limit on Developers; it will keep failing. Need more than 120 requests a minute? Batching almost always removes the need. If it does not, email support@sendletter.app with what you are doing. // Node: send a long list in batches, retrying politely. import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto"; async function sendAll(letters, runId = randomUUID()) { for (let i = 0; i < letters.length; i += 100) { const chunk = letters.slice(i, i + 100); const key = runId + "-" + i; // the same key on every retry of this chunk for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) { const res = await fetch("https://sendletter.app/api/v1/letters/batch", { method: "POST", headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + process.env.SENDLETTER_KEY, "Content-Type": "application/json", "Idempotency-Key": key }, body: JSON.stringify({ letters: chunk }), }); if (res.ok) { const out = await res.json(); if (out.not_processed === 0) break; // done; inspect out.results for errors continue; // ran out of time: send the same chunk again } if (res.status === 429 || res.status >= 500) { const wait = Number(res.headers.get("retry-after")) || Math.min(60, 2 ** attempt) + Math.random(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, wait * 1000)); continue; } throw new Error("batch failed: " + (await res.text())); // 4xx: fix the request, do not retry blindly } } } Spending limits Every account starts with a limit of $500 a day (Toronto time) across its live keys, so a bug in your code cannot run up a bill. You can set your own limit anywhere up to your approved maximum on Developers . A letter that would take the day's spending over the limit is refused with 429 daily_limit_exceeded and nothing is created. To go above $500 a day, use Request a higher maximum on the same page and tell us what you are sending; we reply by email. Billing No subscription and no minimum. Your first live letter is charged when you send it , before it is accepted, so a card that will not pay is found out on letter one (if it is declined, nothing is sent and you get 402 payment_failed ). After that, usage is invoiced once a month , on the 1st, for the month just ended, as one charge to your saved card. Every invoice lists its letters and is on Invoices , printable and exportable as CSV. Cancelling a queued letter removes it from billing, or refunds it if it was already charged. No GST/HST is charged. OpenAPI, Postman, MCP & llms.txt /openapi.json : the OpenAPI 3.1 description of every endpoint, for code generators and API clients. /postman.json : a Postman collection with a test-key environment. /llms.txt : a plain-text summary for AI assistants. MCP server so an AI agent can quote, send, check and cancel letters: node mcp/sendletter-mcp.mjs with SENDLETTER_API_KEY set (defaults to your test key; see changelog ). Changelog . Questions: support@sendletter.app , answered by the people who run it. text: Can You Mail a Legal Notice or Demand Letter Online? August 2, 2026 Usually not with ordinary lettermail. If a law, a court, or a contract requires you to prove the recipient received your notice, you need Registered Mail, a bailiff, or a process server. Ordinary letter mail — including every online print-and-mail service, ours included — produces no proof of delivery. The distinction that matters Ordinary lettermail Registered Mail Proof you sent it No Yes Signature on delivery No Yes Tracking No Yes Can be sent online end-to-end Yes No — requires a post office Registered Mail exists specifically to create evidence. Canada Post describes it as the service for those who need proof of mailing and proof of delivery . That signature is the entire point, and it is why it cannot be done from a browser: someone has to hand the item over a counter. When proof is actually required This is jurisdiction-specific and this article is not legal advice, but the common cases in Canada are: Formal notice in Quebec ( mise en demeure ). Quebec's own guidance is that a formal notice should be sent by registered mail or served by bailiff, and that you may have to prove receipt to a court. Québec.ca sets out the process . Residential tenancy notices. Most provinces prescribe exactly how a notice to end tenancy or a rent increase must be served, and email is frequently not on the list. Contractual notice clauses. Plenty of commercial agreements specify the delivery method for notices. If yours says registered mail, ordinary mail does not satisfy it, however reasonable that feels. Anything with a limitation period. If a deadline starts running when the other side receives the letter, you need to be able to show when that was. The rule of thumb: if you can imagine standing in front of a decision-maker being asked “how do you know they got it?”, ordinary mail is the wrong tool. Go to a post office and send it Registered, or use a bailiff or process server. What ordinary mail is genuinely fine for Most correspondence, including a lot of correspondence that feels formal: A first approach before anything is in dispute — a polite request to pay an invoice. Invoices, statements, and receipts. Cover letters and supporting documents accompanying an application. Notices where the contract or statute does not prescribe a method. Anything where the recipient is not going to contest having received it. A common middle path Sending the same letter twice, by two methods, is normal practice and often explicitly contemplated: Registered Mail for the evidentiary copy, and an ordinary copy by regular mail or email so the recipient actually reads it promptly rather than waiting on a delivery attempt notice. The registered copy is for the file; the ordinary copy is for the human. And keep a copy of whatever you send, with the date. That costs nothing and is the first thing you will be asked for. If you need proof of receipt, we are the wrong choice, and we would rather say so here than take the order. Quand la preuve est réellement exigée Cela varie selon la juridiction, et le présent article ne constitue pas un avis juridique. Les cas les plus courants au Canada : La mise en demeure au Québec. Les indications du gouvernement du Québec sont claires : la mise en demeure s'envoie par courrier recommandé ou se fait signifier par huissier, et vous pourriez devoir prouver la réception devant le tribunal. Québec.ca détaille la démarche . Les avis en matière de logement. La plupart des provinces prescrivent exactement comment signifier un avis de reprise, de résiliation ou d'augmentation de loyer. Le courriel ne figure souvent pas dans la liste. Les clauses de notification contractuelles. Beaucoup de contrats commerciaux imposent le mode d'envoi des avis. Si le vôtre dit « courrier recommandé », le courrier ordinaire ne satisfait pas à la clause, aussi raisonnable que cela puisse paraître. Tout ce qui met en marche un délai. Si un délai commence à courir à la réception de la lettre, vous devez pouvoir établir cette date. La règle empirique : si vous pouvez imaginer qu'on vous demande, devant un décideur, « comment savez-vous qu'il l'a reçue ? », le courrier ordinaire est le mauvais outil. Passez au bureau de poste et envoyez en recommandé, ou faites appel à un huissier. Ce à quoi le courrier ordinaire convient très bien L'essentiel de la correspondance, y compris beaucoup de courrier qui paraît formel : Une première approche avant tout litige — une demande polie de régler une facture. description: When postal mail beats email, what a print-and-mail API request actually looks like, and the four gotchas that bite teams shipping physical mail for the first time.
text: Sending Physical Mail From Your App: A Practical API Guide August 2, 2026 A print-and-mail API turns an HTTP request into a physical letter: you POST the recipient, the sender, and the content, and a printer somewhere produces paper that enters the postal system. It is worth reaching for in the specific cases where email does not do the job. When paper beats email The email bounced. Postal addresses decay far more slowly than email addresses. For win-back and collections, mail reaches people your list has lost. The rules require paper. Plenty of statutory and regulatory notices still specify mail, and a spam folder is not a defence. You need to be read. A letter competes with four other envelopes; an email competes with three hundred messages. What it is not good for is anything time-critical. Canada Post's Lettermail standard is two to four business days after posting, an estimate and not a guarantee. If it has to arrive tomorrow, mail is the wrong channel regardless of how good the API is. What a request looks like The shape is consistent across providers: authenticate with a key, describe the two addresses, supply the content, get back an id. Ours takes structured fields, raw HTML, or a base64 PDF: curl -X POST https://sendletter.app/api/v1/send \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sl_live_..." \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "mode": "draft", "letter_size": "standard", "from": { "name": "Acme Inc.", "line1": "100 Queen St W", "city": "Toronto", "province": "ON", "postal_code": "M5H 2N2", "country": "CA" }, "to": { "name": "Jane Doe", "line1": "1 Rue Sainte-Catherine", "city": "Montreal", "province": "QC", "postal_code": "H2X 1K4", "country": "CA" }, "letter": { "salutation": "Dear Ms. Doe,", "body": "Your subscription renews on 1 September.", "closing": "Sincerely,", "signature": "Acme Billing" } }' Four things that bite first-timers 1. Retries send real paper. This is the big one. A retried API call that fails halfway can produce two physical letters, and you cannot recall the second. Send an Idempotency-Key header with every create request (tie it to your own record, such as an invoice number) and reuse the same key on every retry: sendletter then returns the original letter instead of mailing a second one. Store the returned id as soon as you have it. 2. Addresses fail late. A bad email bounces in seconds. A bad postal address fails days later, silently, and often without telling you. Validate the postal code format up front — Canadian codes are letter-digit-letter digit-letter-digit — and always set a return address so undeliverable mail comes back instead of being destroyed. 3. Page count changes the price and the envelope. A tri-fold envelope holds a handful of sheets; past that you are into a flat envelope at a higher rate. If your content is user-generated, its length is now a billing input. Count pages before you send, not after. 4. Cost per piece is the whole cost model. There is no free tier in physics. Postage and printing put a hard floor under every letter, so unit economics matter in a way they never do for email. Check whether a provider adds a platform fee or monthly minimum on top of the per-piece price. Picking a provider Be honest about which lane you are in. If you are running bulk direct-mail campaigns with audience segmentation, address verification at scale, and per-campaign analytics, the established platforms — Lob and PostGrid among them — are built for exactly that and you should use one. Where we fit: sendletter does one letter at a time, delivered to Canadian addresses, billed per piece with no monthly fee, and with automatic volume pricing that takes a letter to as low as $1.69 all in ( rates and calculator ). The API now has test keys, idempotency keys, status, cancellation, webhooks and a bulk endpoint. Sending addresses can be anywhere in the world; delivery is Canada only. text: Envoyer du courrier papier depuis votre application : guide d'API 2 août 2026 Une API d'impression et de postage transforme une requête HTTP en lettre physique : vous transmettez le destinataire, l'expéditeur et le contenu, et une imprimante quelque part produit du papier qui entre dans le réseau postal. Elle vaut le détour dans les cas précis où le courriel ne suffit pas. Quand le papier bat le courriel Le courriel a rebondi. Les adresses postales se périment beaucoup plus lentement que les adresses de courriel. Pour la reconquête de clients et le recouvrement, la poste rejoint des gens que votre liste a perdus. La réglementation impose le papier. De nombreux avis légaux ou réglementaires exigent encore la poste, et un dossier de pourriels n'est pas une défense. Vous devez être lu. Une lettre affronte quatre autres enveloppes ; un courriel en affronte trois cents. Ce à quoi elle ne convient pas , c'est l'urgence. La norme de livraison de Postes Canada est de deux à quatre jours ouvrables après la mise à la poste, une estimation et non une garantie. Si l'envoi doit arriver demain, la poste est le mauvais canal, quelle que soit la qualité de l'API. À quoi ressemble une requête La forme est comparable d'un fournisseur à l'autre : on s'authentifie avec une clé, on décrit les deux adresses, on fournit le contenu, on reçoit un identifiant. La nôtre accepte des champs structurés, du HTML brut ou un PDF encodé en base64 : curl -X POST https://sendletter.app/api/v1/send \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sl_live_..." \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "mode": "draft", "letter_size": "standard", "from": { "name": "Acme inc.", "line1": "100 rue Queen O", "city": "Toronto", "province": "ON", "postal_code": "M5H 2N2", "country": "CA" }, "to": { "name": "Jeanne Tremblay", "line1": "1 rue Sainte-Catherine", "city": "Montreal", "province": "QC", "postal_code": "H2X 1K4", "country": "CA" }, "letter": { "salutation": "Madame Tremblay,", "body": "Votre abonnement se renouvelle le 1er septembre.", "closing": "Cordialement,", "signature": "Facturation Acme" } }' Quatre pièges d'une première intégration 1. Une reprise imprime du vrai papier. C'est le piège principal. Un appel repris après un échec partiel peut produire deux lettres physiques, et vous ne pouvez pas rappeler la seconde. Envoyez un en-tête Idempotency-Key avec chaque création (liez-le à votre propre enregistrement, par exemple un numéro de facture) et réutilisez la même clé à chaque reprise : sendletter renvoie alors la lettre d'origine au lieu d'en poster une seconde. Enregistrez l'identifiant retourné dès que vous l'avez. 2. Les adresses échouent tard. Un courriel invalide rebondit en quelques secondes. Une adresse postale erronée échoue des jours plus tard, en silence, et souvent sans vous prévenir. Validez le format du code postal en amont — au Canada, lettre-chiffre-lettre chiffre-lettre-chiffre — et indiquez toujours une adresse de retour, sans quoi le courrier non distribuable est détruit au lieu de revenir. 3. Le nombre de pages change le prix et l'enveloppe. Une enveloppe pour pli en trois contient quelques feuilles ; au-delà, vous passez à une enveloppe à plat, à un tarif supérieur. Si votre contenu vient des utilisateurs, sa longueur devient une donnée de facturation. Comptez les pages avant l'envoi, pas après. 4. Le coût unitaire est tout le modèle de coûts. Il n'y a pas de gratuité en physique. L'affranchissement et l'impression posent un plancher dur sous chaque lettre : la rentabilité unitaire compte ici comme elle ne compte jamais pour le courriel. Vérifiez si un fournisseur ajoute des frais de plateforme ou un minimum mensuel par-dessus le prix unitaire. Choisir un fournisseur Soyez honnête sur votre créneau. Si vous menez des campagnes de publipostage en masse, avec segmentation d'auditoire, validation d'adresses à grande échelle et analyse par campagne, les plateformes établies — Lob et PostGrid notamment — sont conçues exactement pour cela et c'est vers elles qu'il faut aller. L'adresse d'expéditeur peut se trouver n'importe où dans le monde ; la livraison se fait au Canada seulement. S'il vous faut des outils de campagne en masse ou une livraison hors Canada, prenez l'une des plateformes ci-dessus : ce sera moins de travail que de plier la nôtre à cet usage. title: Idempotency Keys for Physical Mail | sendletter
description: Why a retried mail API request can post a second letter you cannot recall, and how an idempotency key prevents it. How to use one, and what to check.
text: Idempotency Keys for Physical Mail November 26, 2026 An idempotency key makes a retried request return the original result instead of repeating it. For physical mail that matters more than for email: a duplicate request prints and posts a second letter you cannot recall. Send a unique key with every create request, and reuse that same key on every retry of the same request. Why letters are different A network timeout leaves you not knowing whether your request arrived. With email, sending twice is an annoyance. With a letter, a second request can mean a second piece of paper in someone's mailbox and a second charge, and once it is printed it cannot be recalled. The safe pattern is to retry, but only in a way the API recognises as the same request. How it works with sendletter Situation Result Same key, same request, already finished The original response again, marked Idempotent-Replayed: true. No second letter, no second charge. Same key, same request, still running 409 request_in_progress. Retry shortly with the same key. Same key, different request 422 idempotency_key_reuse. The first attempt failed validation or payment The key is released, so you can fix the request and retry with it. Only successful responses are stored and replayed, not errors. text: भारत से कनाडा पत्र कैसे भेजें (2026) भारत से कनाडा पत्र भेजने के दो तरीके हैं: भारतीय डाक से अंतरराष्ट्रीय डाक, या कोई ऐसी सेवा जो कनाडा में ही पत्र छापकर घरेलू डाक से भेजे। दोनों में सबसे बड़ी गलती एक ही होती है — पता। कनाडा का पता भारतीय पते से अलग क्रम और अलग प्रारूप में लिखा जाता है। कनाडा का पता कैसे लिखें भारत में पिन कोड छह अंकों का होता है और केवल संख्याओं से बनता है। कनाडा का पोस्टल कोड ऐसा नहीं है: यह अक्षर-अंक-अक्षर, फिर स्थान, फिर अंक-अक्षर-अंक होता है — जैसे M5H 2N2। यह पते की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण पंक्ति है, क्योंकि कनाडा पोस्ट सबसे पहले इसी को पढ़ती है। दूसरी आम गलती है प्रांत का नाम पूरा लिखना; कनाडा में दो अक्षरों का कोड इस्तेमाल होता है। भारतीय प्रारूप श्री राजेश कुमार फ्लैट 4बी, ग्रीन पार्क अपार्टमेंट्स एम.जी. रोड बेंगलुरु, कर्नाटक 560001 भारत कनाडाई प्रारूप RAJESH KUMAR 4B-123 MAIN ST W TORONTO ON M5H 2N2 CANADA भारतीय पते को कनाडाई प्रारूप में बदलना फ्लैट या यूनिट संख्या सड़क संख्या से पहले, हाइफ़न के साथ लिखें — 4B-123, न कि 'फ्लैट 4बी' अलग पंक्ति में। शहर, दो अक्षरों वाला प्रांत कोड और पोस्टल कोड — तीनों एक ही पंक्ति में। प्रांत का नाम पूरा न लिखें: Ontario नहीं, ON लिखें। Quebec के लिए QC, British Columbia के लिए BC। अंतिम पंक्ति में केवल CANADA लिखें, बड़े अक्षरों में। पूरा पता रोमन लिपि में लिखें। देवनागरी में लिखा पता कनाडा में पढ़ा नहीं जा सकेगा। लिपि पता पूरी तरह अंग्रेज़ी वर्णमाला (रोमन लिपि) में होना चाहिए। आप लिफ़ाफ़े पर अपना संदेश हिंदी में लिख सकते हैं, लेकिन पता — नाम, सड़क, शहर, प्रांत, पोस्टल कोड — रोमन लिपि में ही होना चाहिए, अन्यथा कनाडा की छँटाई मशीनें उसे पढ़ नहीं पाएँगी। कितना समय लगता है भारतीय डाक से भेजा गया अंतरराष्ट्रीय पत्र आमतौर पर दो से चार सप्ताह लेता है, और सीमा शुल्क व हवाई परिवहन के आधार पर इससे अधिक भी। कनाडा के भीतर से भेजा गया पत्र कनाडा पोस्ट के अनुसार तीन से सात कार्य दिवस लेता है। कनाडा में भारतीय समुदाय मुख्यतः ग्रेटर टोरंटो क्षेत्र (ब्रैम्पटन, मिसिसॉगा, स्कारबोरो), ग्रेटर वैंकूवर (सरे, एबॉट्सफ़ोर्ड) और कैलगरी व एडमंटन में केंद्रित है। इन क्षेत्रों में पते अक्सर यूनिट संख्या के साथ आते हैं — उसे छोड़ना डाक न पहुँचने का सामान्य कारण है। यदि पत्र न पहुँचे यह महत्वपूर्ण है: जब हम आपकी ओर से पत्र भेजते हैं, वह कनाडा में छपता है और कनाडा की घरेलू डाक के रूप में भेजा जाता है, जबकि वापसी का पता भारत का होता है। यदि कनाडाई पता ग़लत हुआ, तो पत्र भारत वापस नहीं भेजा जा सकता — अंतरराष्ट्रीय वापसी डाक शुल्क चुकाया ही नहीं गया होता। कनाडा पोस्ट के अपने नियमों के अनुसार ऐसी डाक खोली जाती है और यदि उसका कोई स्पष्ट मूल्य न हो तो नष्ट कर दी जाती है। आपको कोई सूचना नहीं मिलेगी। इसीलिए पता भेजने से पहले दो बार जाँचें। अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले प्रश्न क्या मैं पता हिंदी में लिख सकता हूँ? नहीं। पता रोमन लिपि title: ਭਾਰਤ ਤੋਂ ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਭੇਜਣੀ ਹੈ (2026) | sendletter
description: ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਦਾ ਪਤਾ ਸਹੀ ਲਿਖਣ ਦਾ ਤਰੀਕਾ, ਪੋਸਟਲ ਕੋਡ ਦਾ ਰੂਪ, ਅਤੇ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਨਾ ਪਹੁੰਚਣ 'ਤੇ ਕੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
text: ਭਾਰਤ ਤੋਂ ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਭੇਜਣੀ ਹੈ (2026) ਭਾਰਤ ਤੋਂ ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਭੇਜਣ ਦੇ ਦੋ ਰਾਹ ਹਨ: ਭਾਰਤੀ ਡਾਕ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਅੰਤਰਰਾਸ਼ਟਰੀ ਡਾਕ, ਜਾਂ ਕੋਈ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੀ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਛਾਪ ਕੇ ਘਰੇਲੂ ਡਾਕ ਵਜੋਂ ਭੇਜੇ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੀ ਗਲਤੀ ਇੱਕੋ ਹੈ — ਪਤਾ। ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਦਾ ਪਤਾ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਲਿਖਣਾ ਹੈ ਭਾਰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਿੰਨ ਕੋਡ ਛੇ ਅੰਕਾਂ ਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਦਾ ਪੋਸਟਲ ਕੋਡ ਅੱਖਰ ਅਤੇ ਅੰਕ ਰਲਾ ਕੇ ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ — ਜਿਵੇਂ L6T 3R5। ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਪੋਸਟ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਇਹੀ ਪੜ੍ਹਦੀ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਗਲਤ ਜਾਂ ਗੈਰਹਾਜ਼ਰ ਪੋਸਟਲ ਕੋਡ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ। ਭਾਰਤੀ ਰੂਪ ਸ. ਹਰਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਸਿੰਘ ਮਕਾਨ ਨੰ. 250, ਗਲੀ ਨੰ. 8 ਮਾਡਲ ਟਾਊਨ ਲੁਧਿਆਣਾ, ਪੰਜਾਬ 141002 ਭਾਰਤ ਕੈਨੇਡੀਅਨ ਰੂਪ HARPREET SINGH 42-3200 CASTLEMORE RD BRAMPTON ON L6P 1V2 CANADA ਭਾਰਤੀ ਪਤੇ ਨੂੰ ਕੈਨੇਡੀਅਨ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲਣਾ ਯੂਨਿਟ ਜਾਂ ਅਪਾਰਟਮੈਂਟ ਨੰਬਰ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ, ਡੈਸ਼ ਨਾਲ — 42-3200। ਸ਼ਹਿਰ, ਦੋ ਅੱਖਰਾਂ ਦਾ ਸੂਬਾ ਕੋਡ ਅਤੇ ਪੋਸਟਲ ਕੋਡ ਇੱਕੋ ਲਾਈਨ ਵਿੱਚ। ਸੂਬੇ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਨਾ ਲਿਖੋ: Ontario ਨਹੀਂ, ON। ਆਖਰੀ ਲਾਈਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿਰਫ਼ CANADA। ਪੂਰਾ ਪਤਾ ਰੋਮਨ ਲਿਪੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਿਖੋ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ। ਲਿਪੀ ਪਤਾ ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਅੱਖਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਣਾ ਲਾਜ਼ਮੀ ਹੈ। ਚਿੱਠੀ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਿਖ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ — ਪਰ ਲਿਫ਼ਾਫ਼ੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਪਤਾ ਰੋਮਨ ਲਿਪੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੀ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। ਕਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਭਾਰਤੀ ਡਾਕ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਅੰਤਰਰਾਸ਼ਟਰੀ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਆਮ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਦੋ ਤੋਂ ਚਾਰ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਲੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰੋਂ ਭੇਜੀ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਪੋਸਟ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਤਿੰਨ ਤੋਂ ਸੱਤ ਕੰਮਕਾਜੀ ਦਿਨ ਲੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਭਾਈਚਾਰਾ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਬਰੈਂਪਟਨ ਅਤੇ ਮਿਸੀਸਾਗਾ (ਓਂਟਾਰੀਓ), ਸਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਐਬਟਸਫੋਰਡ (ਬ੍ਰਿਟਿਸ਼ ਕੋਲੰਬੀਆ), ਅਤੇ ਕੈਲਗਰੀ ਤੇ ਐਡਮਿੰਟਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੈ। ਇਹਨਾਂ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਪਤਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਕਸਰ ਯੂਨਿਟ ਨੰਬਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ — ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡਣਾ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਗੁਆਉਣ ਦਾ ਆਮ ਕਾਰਨ ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਨਾ ਪਹੁੰਚੇ ਇਹ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ: ਜਦੋਂ ਅਸੀਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਭੇਜਦੇ ਹਾਂ, ਉਹ ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਛਪਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਘਰੇਲੂ ਡਾਕ ਵਜੋਂ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਦਕਿ ਵਾਪਸੀ ਦਾ ਪਤਾ ਭਾਰਤ ਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਕੈਨੇਡੀਅਨ ਪਤਾ ਗਲਤ ਹੋਵੇ, ਤਾਂ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਭਾਰਤ ਵਾਪਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਭੇਜੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ — ਅੰਤਰਰਾਸ਼ਟਰੀ ਵਾਪਸੀ ਡਾਕ ਖਰਚ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਗਿਆ ਹੁੰਦਾ। ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਪੋਸਟ ਦੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਅਜਿਹੀ ਡਾਕ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਜੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਕੋਈ ਸਪੱਸ਼ਟ ਕੀਮਤ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲੇਗੀ। ਆਮ ਸਵਾਲ ਕੀ ਮੈਂ ਪਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਿਖ ਸਕਦਾ ਹਾਂ? ਨਹੀਂ। ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਪੋਸਟ ਦੀਆਂ ਮਸ਼ੀਨਾਂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੜ੍ਹਦੀਆਂ। ਪਤਾ ਰੋਮਨ ਲਿਪੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। ਬਰੈਂਪਟਨ ਦਾ ਪੋਸਟਲ ਕੋਡ ਕਿਹੋ ਜਿਹਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ? ਬਰੈਂਪਟਨ ਦੇ ਪੋਸਟਲ ਕੋਡ L ਨਾਲ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਜਿਵੇਂ L6P 1V2। ਪਹਿਲੇ ਤਿੰਨ ਅੱਖਰ ਇਲਾਕਾ ਦੱਸਦੇ ਹਨ, ਅਗਲੇ ਤਿੰਨ ਗਲੀ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ। ਕੀ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਦੀ ਟਰੈਕਿੰਗ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ? title: Paano Magpadala ng Sulat sa Canada Mula sa Pilipinas (2026) | sendletter
description: Tamang pagsulat ng address sa Canada, ang format ng postal code, at kung ano ang mangyayari kapag hindi naihatid ang sulat.
text: Paano Magpadala ng Sulat sa Canada Mula sa Pilipinas (2026) May dalawang paraan para magpadala ng sulat sa Canada mula sa Pilipinas: sa pamamagitan ng PHLPost bilang international mail, o sa isang serbisyong nagpi-print ng sulat sa loob mismo ng Canada at ipinapadala bilang domestic mail. Sa dalawang paraan, iisa ang pinakamadalas na pagkakamali — ang address. Paano isulat ang address sa Canada Sa Pilipinas, karaniwang kasama sa address ang barangay, at apat na digit ang ZIP code. Sa Canada walang katumbas ang barangay — kapag isinama mo ito bilang dagdag na linya, wala itong ibig sabihin sa Canada Post at maaaring makalito sa paghahatid. Ang postal code naman ay hindi puro numero: halinhinan ang letra at numero, tulad ng M5H 2N2, at ito ang unang binabasa ng makina. Format sa Pilipinas Mr. Juan dela Cruz Blk 12 Lot 5, Sampaguita St. Barangay San Antonio Pasig City, Metro Manila 1600 Philippines Format sa Canada JUAN DELA CRUZ 512-3300 DON MILLS RD NORTH YORK ON M2J 4X7 CANADA Pagpapalit ng address ng Pilipinas sa format ng Canada Alisin ang barangay. Walang katumbas nito sa Canada at hindi ito kailangan. Ilagay ang unit o apartment number bago ang building number, may gitling — 512-3300. Pagsamahin sa isang linya ang lungsod, ang dalawang-letrang province code, at ang postal code. Gamitin ang daglat ng probinsya: ON para sa Ontario, BC para sa British Columbia, AB para sa Alberta. Sa huling linya, CANADA lamang, naka-capital letters. Gaano katagal Ang international mail mula sa PHLPost ay karaniwang tumatagal ng dalawa hanggang apat na linggo. Ang sulat na ipinadala mula sa loob ng Canada ay tumatagal ng tatlo hanggang pitong araw ng trabaho ayon sa Canada Post. Ang komunidad ng mga Pilipino sa Canada ay pinakamalaki sa Greater Toronto Area (North York, Scarborough, Mississauga), Winnipeg — na may isa sa pinakamatandang Pilipinong komunidad sa bansa — at Greater Vancouver. Karaniwang may unit number ang mga address sa mga lugar na ito, at ang pagkalimot dito ay madalas na dahilan ng hindi naihatid na sulat. Kapag hindi naihatid Mahalaga ito: kapag kami ang nagpadala para sa iyo, ipi-print ang sulat sa Canada at ipapadala bilang domestic mail ng Canada, samantalang ang return address ay nasa Pilipinas. Kung mali ang address sa Canada, hindi maibabalik ang sulat sa iyo — hindi kailanman nabayaran ang international return postage. Ayon mismo sa patakaran ng Canada Post, binubuksan ang ganitong mail at sinisira kung walang malinaw na halaga. Walang abiso na darating sa iyo. Kaya tiyakin munang tama ang address bago magpadala. Mga madalas itanong Kailangan ko bang isulat ang barangay? Hindi. Walang barangay sa sistema ng Canada. Ang pagsama nito ay nagdaragdag lamang ng linyang hindi nauunawaan ng Canada Post. Ano ang hitsura ng postal code sa Canada? Anim na karakter, halinhinan ang letra at numero, may isang espasyo sa gitna: A1A 1A1. Hindi ito apat na digit tulad ng ZIP code sa Pilipinas. May tracking ba ang sulat? Walang tracking ang ordinaryong lettermail. Kung kailangan mo ng patunay ng paghahatid, Registered Mail ang kailangan, at ito ay maipapadala lamang mula sa post office sa Canada. Magpadala ng sulat sa Canada Isulat o i-upload ang sulat, ilagay ang address sa Canada, at ipi-print namin ito sa Canada at ipapadala sa pamamagitan ng Canada Post. Mula 3.49 CAD, kasama na ang print at buwis. text: 如何从中国寄信到加拿大（2026） 从中国寄信到加拿大有两种方式：通过中国邮政的国际信函，或使用在加拿大本地打印并按国内邮件寄出的服务。两种方式最常见的错误是同一个——地址顺序写反了。 加拿大地址怎么写 中文地址从大到小书写：国家、省、市、区、街道、门牌、姓名。加拿大完全相反，从小到大：姓名、门牌与街道、城市与省份与邮编、国家。把中文习惯直接搬到加拿大信封上，分拣机器无法识别。此外，加拿大邮编不是六位数字，而是字母与数字交替的六位组合，如 M5H 2N2。 中文写法（从大到小） 中国 广东省 深圳市 南山区 科技园南路 123号 阳光大厦 8楼 802室 王小明 先生 邮编 518057 加拿大写法（从小到大） XIAOMING WANG 802-4180 KINGSWAY BURNABY BC V5H 4T6 CANADA 把中文地址改成加拿大格式 把顺序整个颠倒过来：收件人姓名在第一行，国家在最后一行。 房间号或单元号写在门牌号之前，用连字符连接——802-4180，不要单独成行。 城市、两个字母的省份缩写、邮政编码写在同一行。 省份使用两字母缩写：安大略省是 ON，不列颠哥伦比亚省是 BC，魁北克省是 QC。 最后一行只写 CANADA，用大写字母。 文字 地址必须使用拉丁字母（英文）书写。加拿大邮政的分拣设备不识别汉字，用中文书写的地址只能靠人工处理，通常意味着延误或根本无法投递。信件内容可以用中文，但信封上的地址不行。 需要多长时间 通过中国邮政寄出的国际信函通常需要两到四周，视航空运力和海关而定。从加拿大境内寄出的信件，按加拿大邮政的说法需要三到七个工作日。 加拿大的华人社区主要集中在大温哥华地区（列治文、本拿比）、大多伦多地区（万锦、列治文山、士嘉堡）以及蒙特利尔。这些地区的住址常带单元号，遗漏单元号是投递失败的常见原因。 如果信件无法投递 请务必注意：我们代您寄信时，信件在加拿大打印并作为加拿大国内邮件寄出，而回邮地址是您在中国的地址。如果加拿大地址有误，信件无法退回中国——国际退件邮资从未支付过。按加拿大邮政自己的规定，这类邮件会被拆开，若无明显价值即予销毁。您不会收到任何通知。因此寄出前请务必核对地址。 常见问题 可以用中文写地址吗？ 不可以。加拿大邮政的分拣机器不识别汉字。地址必须用拉丁字母书写，否则信件很可能无法投递。 加拿大的邮政编码是什么样的？ 六个字符，字母与数字交替，中间有一个空格：A1A 1A1。例如多伦多的 M5H 2N2。它不是六位数字。 信件有跟踪查询吗？ 普通信函没有跟踪服务。如果需要投递证明，需要使用挂号信，而挂号信只能在加拿大的邮局柜台交寄。 寄信到加拿大 撰写或上传信件，填写加拿大地址，我们在加拿大打印并通过加拿大邮政寄出。3.49 加元起，含打印与税费。 寄出信件 其他语言 India (Hindi) India (Punjabi) Philippines Hong Kong / Taiwan (Traditional Chinese) Mexico, Latin America, Spain Arabic-speaking countries

title: Cómo enviar una carta a Canadá (2026) | sendletter
description: Cómo escribir correctamente una dirección canadiense, cómo es el código postal y qué ocurre si la carta no se puede entregar.
text: Cómo enviar una carta a Canadá (2026) Hay dos formas de enviar una carta a Canadá: por correo internacional a través del servicio postal de tu país, o mediante un servicio que imprime la carta dentro de Canadá y la envía como correo nacional. En ambos casos, el error más común es el mismo — la dirección. Cómo escribir una dirección canadiense Dos costumbres estorban. La colonia en México, o el barrio en otros países, no tienen equivalente en Canadá: escribirlos añade una línea que Canada Post no entiende. Y el código postal va antes de la ciudad en español, mientras que en Canadá cierra la línea, después de la provincia. Además el código canadiense no es numérico: alterna letra y número, como M5H 2N2. Formato hispano Sr. Carlos Hernández Av. Insurgentes Sur 1234, Depto. 5 Col. Del Valle 03100 Ciudad de México, CDMX México Formato canadiense CARLOS HERNANDEZ 5-1234 ST CLAIR AVE W TORONTO ON M6E 1B4 CANADA Convertir una dirección hispana al formato canadiense Elimina la línea de la colonia o el barrio: no existe en el sistema canadiense. El número del departamento va antes del número del edificio, con guion — 5-1234. Ciudad, código de provincia de dos letras y código postal, todo en la misma línea. Nunca escribas la provincia completa: ON en lugar de Ontario, QC en lugar de Quebec. Quita los acentos y la eñe: Hernández se escribe HERNANDEZ, Muñoz se escribe MUNOZ. Caracteres El alfabeto ya es latino, pero los acentos y la ñ pueden leerse mal en los equipos canadienses. Escribe la dirección sin tildes. Dentro de la carta puedes escribir con normalidad. Cuánto tarda Una carta internacional suele tardar de dos a cuatro semanas, según el país de origen. Una carta despachada dentro de Canadá tarda de tres a siete días hábiles según Canada Post. Las comunidades hispanohablantes en Canadá se concentran en Toronto, Montreal (con una fuerte presencia colombiana, mexicana y salvadoreña), Vancouver y Calgary. Muchas direcciones en estas ciudades incluyen número de unidad, y omitirlo es una causa habitual de no entrega. Si la carta no llega Esto es importante: cuando enviamos la carta en tu nombre, se imprime en Canadá y se despacha como correo nacional canadiense, mientras que la dirección de remitente está en tu país. Si la dirección canadiense es incorrecta, la carta no puede devolverse — nunca se pagó el franqueo de retorno internacional. Según las propias normas de Canada Post, ese correo se abre y se destruye si no tiene un valor evidente. No recibirás ningún aviso. Por eso conviene revisar la dirección dos veces antes de enviar. Preguntas frecuentes ¿Debo escribir la colonia o el barrio? No. En Canadá no existe esa división. Incluirla solo añade una línea que Canada Post no interpreta. ¿Cómo es un código postal canadiense? Seis caracteres alternando letra y número, con un espacio en medio: A1A 1A1. No es numérico como el de México o España. ¿La carta tiene seguimiento? El correo ordinario no tiene seguimiento. Si necesitas prueba de entrega, hace falta correo certificado, que solo puede despacharse desde una oficina postal en Canadá. title: Envoyer une lettre au Canada : le guide (2026) | sendletter
description: Comment écrire correctement une adresse canadienne, le format du code postal, et ce qui se passe si la lettre ne peut pas être distribuée.
text: Envoyer une lettre au Canada : le guide (2026) Deux possibilités pour envoyer une lettre au Canada : le courrier international via La Poste, ou un service qui imprime la lettre au Canada et la poste comme courrier intérieur. Dans les deux cas, l'erreur la plus fréquente est la même — l'adresse. Comment écrire une adresse canadienne Deux habitudes françaises posent problème. Le code postal se place avant la commune (« 75001 Paris »), alors qu'au Canada il vient en fin de ligne, après la province. Et le numéro précède bien la voie en France, ce qui tombe juste — mais la mention du complément d'adresse (bâtiment, escalier, appartement) sur une ligne séparée, elle, n'a pas d'équivalent : au Canada le numéro d'appartement se colle au numéro de voie avec un trait d'union. Format français Monsieur Jean Dupont Bâtiment C, Appartement 12 5 rue de la République 75011 Paris France Format canadien JEAN DUPONT 12-5 RUE SAINTE-CATHERINE O MONTREAL QC H3B 1A7 CANADA Convertir une adresse française au format canadien Fusionnez l'appartement avec le numéro de voie, séparés par un trait d'union — 12-5. Supprimez la ligne « Bâtiment » : elle n'a pas d'équivalent canadien. Ville, code de province à deux lettres et code postal sur une seule ligne. N'écrivez jamais la province en toutes lettres : QC et non Québec, ON et non Ontario. Le code postal canadien se place en dernier sur cette ligne, jamais devant la ville. Délais Une lettre internationale depuis la France met généralement une à deux semaines. Une lettre postée depuis le Canada met de trois à sept jours ouvrables selon Postes Canada. Au Canada, les francophones d'origine française, belge, suisse et camerounaise se concentrent à Montréal et dans sa région, à Québec, à Ottawa-Gatineau et à Moncton. À noter : au Québec, les adresses s'écrivent en français, mais la structure reste canadienne — l'ordre et le code postal ne changent pas. Si la lettre n'arrive pas Point important : lorsque nous envoyons la lettre pour vous, elle est imprimée au Canada et postée comme courrier intérieur canadien, alors que l'adresse de retour se trouve en France. Si l'adresse canadienne est erronée, la lettre ne peut pas vous être renvoyée — l'affranchissement de retour international n'a jamais été payé. Selon les propres règles de Postes Canada, ce courrier est ouvert puis détruit s'il n'a pas de valeur apparente. Vous ne recevrez aucun avis. Vérifiez donc l'adresse deux fois avant l'envoi. Questions fréquentes Où placer le code postal ? En fin de ligne, après le code de province : « MONTREAL QC H3B 1A7 ». Jamais devant la ville comme en France. À quoi ressemble un code postal canadien ? Six caractères alternant lettre et chiffre, avec une espace au milieu : A1A 1A1. Il est obligatoire. La lettre est-elle suivie ? Le courrier ordinaire n'offre aucun suivi. S'il vous faut une preuve de réception, il faut le courrier recommandé, qui ne peut être déposé que dans un bureau de poste au Canada. Envoyer une lettre au Canada Rédigez ou téléversez votre lettre, ajoutez l'adresse canadienne : nous l'imprimons au Canada et la postons via Postes Canada. title: Como enviar uma carta para o Canadá (2026) | sendletter
description: Como escrever corretamente um endereço canadense, como é o código postal e o que acontece se a carta não puder ser entregue.
text: Como enviar uma carta para o Canadá (2026) Há duas maneiras de enviar uma carta para o Canadá: pelo correio internacional dos Correios, ou por um serviço que imprime a carta dentro do próprio Canadá e a posta como correspondência nacional. Nos dois casos, o erro mais comum é o mesmo — o endereço. Como escrever um endereço canadense O bairro, obrigatório num endereço brasileiro, não tem equivalente no Canadá: mantê-lo acrescenta uma linha que os Correios canadenses não interpretam. Além disso o CEP brasileiro tem oito dígitos e vem antes da cidade, enquanto o código postal canadense alterna letra e número — M5H 2N2 — e fecha a linha, depois da sigla da província. Formato brasileiro Sr. João Silva Rua das Flores, 250, Apto. 32 Bairro Jardim Paulista São Paulo - SP, 01415-000 Brasil Formato canadense JOAO SILVA 32-250 DUNDAS ST W TORONTO ON M5T 1H1 CANADA Converter um endereço brasileiro para o formato canadense Remova a linha do bairro — não existe no sistema canadense. O número do apartamento vem antes do número do prédio, com hífen — 32-250. O número vem antes do nome da rua: de « Rua das Flores, 250 » para « 250 Dundas St ». Cidade, sigla da província com duas letras e código postal na mesma linha. Tire os acentos: João vira JOAO, Conceição vira CONCEICAO. Caracteres O alfabeto já é latino, mas os acentos e o til podem ser lidos incorretamente pelos equipamentos canadenses. Escreva o endereço sem acentuação. No corpo da carta isso não importa. Quanto tempo leva Uma carta internacional dos Correios costuma levar de duas a quatro semanas. Uma carta postada dentro do Canadá leva de três a sete dias úteis, segundo o Canada Post. A comunidade brasileira e portuguesa no Canadá está concentrada em Toronto (a Little Portugal na Dundas Street é histórica), Montreal e Vancouver. Muitos endereços nessas áreas têm número de unidade. Se a carta não chegar Isto é importante: quando enviamos a carta em seu nome, ela é impressa no Canadá e postada como correspondência nacional canadense, enquanto o endereço do remetente está no Brasil. Se o endereço canadense estiver errado, a carta não pode ser devolvida — a tarifa internacional de devolução nunca foi paga. Pelas próprias regras do Canada Post, esse tipo de correspondência é aberto e destruído se não tiver valor evidente. Você não receberá nenhum aviso. Por isso, confira o endereço duas vezes antes de enviar. Perguntas frequentes Preciso escrever o bairro? Não. O Canadá não usa bairros no endereçamento. Incluir essa linha só acrescenta informação que o Canada Post não interpreta. Como é o código postal canadense? Seis caracteres alternando letra e número, com um espaço no meio: A1A 1A1. Não tem oito dígitos como o CEP. A carta tem rastreamento? A correspondência comum não tem rastreamento. Se precisar de comprovante de entrega, é necessário o correio registrado, que só pode ser postado numa agência no Canadá. text: Cách gửi thư đi Canada từ Việt Nam (2026) Có hai cách gửi thư từ Việt Nam sang Canada: gửi thư quốc tế qua Bưu điện Việt Nam, hoặc dùng dịch vụ in thư ngay tại Canada rồi gửi như thư nội địa. Canada thì ngược lại: bắt đầu bằng tên người nhận và kết thúc bằng tên quốc gia. Ngoài ra, mã bưu chính Việt Nam gồm sáu chữ số, còn mã bưu chính Canada xen kẽ chữ và số — dạng M5H 2N2. Đây là dòng mà Canada Post đọc trước tiên. Kiểu Việt Nam (lớn đến nhỏ) Ông Nguyễn Văn An Số 25, ngõ 108, đường Trần Duy Hưng Phường Trung Hòa, Quận Cầu Giấy Hà Nội 100000 Việt Nam Kiểu Canada (nhỏ đến lớn) AN NGUYEN VAN 808-5000 YONGE ST NORTH YORK ON M2N 7E9 CANADA Chuyển địa chỉ Việt Nam sang kiểu Canada Đảo ngược hoàn toàn thứ tự: dòng đầu là tên người nhận, dòng cuối là tên quốc gia. Số căn hộ đặt trước số nhà, nối bằng dấu gạch ngang — 808-5000. Thành phố, mã tỉnh bang hai chữ cái và mã bưu chính viết trên cùng một dòng. Không có khái niệm phường hay quận trong địa chỉ Canada — bỏ những dòng đó đi. Bỏ hết dấu tiếng Việt. Viết AN NGUYEN VAN, không phải Nguyễn Văn An. Chữ viết Địa chỉ phải viết bằng chữ Latinh không dấu. Máy phân loại của Canada Post không nhận diện được dấu tiếng Việt, và một địa chỉ có dấu có thể bị đọc sai. Nội dung bên trong thư thì viết tiếng Việt có dấu bình thường. Mất bao lâu Thư quốc tế qua Bưu điện Việt Nam thường mất từ hai đến bốn tuần. Địa chỉ ở những khu vực này thường có số căn hộ — bỏ sót số căn hộ là nguyên nhân thường gặp khiến thư không đến nơi. Nếu thư không phát được Điều quan trọng cần biết: khi chúng tôi gửi thư thay bạn, thư được in tại Canada và gửi như thư nội địa Canada, trong khi địa chỉ người gửi lại ở Việt Nam. Nếu địa chỉ Canada sai, thư không thể gửi trả về Việt Nam — cước phí hoàn trả quốc tế chưa bao giờ được thanh toán. Theo quy định của chính Canada Post, thư như vậy sẽ bị mở ra và bị tiêu hủy nếu không có giá trị rõ ràng. Bạn sẽ không nhận được bất kỳ thông báo nào. Vì vậy hãy kiểm tra kỹ địa chỉ trước khi gửi. Câu hỏi thường gặp Tôi có thể viết địa chỉ bằng tiếng Việt có dấu không? Không nên. Hãy bỏ dấu và viết bằng chữ Latinh thường. Máy phân loại của Canada Post có thể đọc sai các ký tự có dấu. Mã bưu chính Canada trông như thế nào? Sáu ký tự, xen kẽ chữ và số, có một khoảng trắng ở giữa: A1A 1A1. Không phải sáu chữ số như ở Việt Nam. Thư có được theo dõi không? Thư thường không có dịch vụ theo dõi. Nếu cần bằng chứng đã phát, bạn cần thư bảo đảm (Registered Mail), chỉ gửi được tại bưu cục ở Canada. text: 日本からカナダへ手紙を送る方法（2026年） 日本からカナダへ手紙を送る方法は二つあります。日本郵便の国際郵便を使うか、カナダ国内で印刷して国内郵便として投函するサービスを使うかです。どちらの場合も、最もよくある失敗は同じ——住所の順序です。 カナダの住所の書き方 日本の住所は大きい単位から小さい単位へ書きます（郵便番号、都道府県、市区町村、丁目・番地、建物名、氏名）。カナダはその逆で、氏名から始まり国名で終わります。日本式の順序をそのまま英字に置き換えると、宛先として成立しません。また日本の郵便番号は数字7桁ですが、カナダは英字と数字が交互に並ぶ6文字——M5H 2N2 のような形です。 日本式（大きい単位から） 〒150-0002 東京都渋谷区渋谷2丁目21-1 渋谷ヒカリエ 1203号室 田中 太郎 様 カナダ式（小さい単位から） TARO TANAKA 1203-1055 W GEORGIA ST VANCOUVER BC V6E 3P3 CANADA 日本式の住所をカナダ式に変換する 順序を完全に逆にします。1行目が受取人の氏名、最終行が国名です。 部屋番号は建物番号の前に置き、ハイフンでつなぎます——1203-1055。別行にはしません。 市、州の2文字コード、郵便番号を同じ行に書きます。 州名は略さず書かないでください。Ontario ではなく ON、British Columbia ではなく BC です。 最終行は CANADA のみ、大文字で書きます。 文字 住所はローマ字（ラテン文字）で書く必要があります。カナダ郵政の区分機は日本語を読み取れません。封筒の宛名が日本語だと手作業に回され、遅延するか届かない可能性があります。手紙の本文は日本語で問題ありません。 所要日数 日本郵便の国際郵便（航空扱い）は通常1〜2週間程度です。カナダ国内から差し出した手紙は、カナダ郵政によれば3〜7営業日かかります。 カナダの日本人・日系コミュニティは、バンクーバー（およびリッチモンド、バーナビー）、トロント、カルガリーに集中しています。これらの地域の住所には部屋番号が付くことが多く、それを省くと配達されない原因になります。 配達できなかった場合 重要な点です。当社がお客様に代わって手紙を送る場合、手紙はカナダで印刷され、カナダ国内郵便として差し出されます。一方、差出人住所は日本のものです。カナダ側の住所が誤っていると、手紙を日本へ返送することはできません——国際返送料が支払われていないためです。カナダ郵政自身の規定により、そうした郵便物は開封され、明らかな価値がなければ廃棄されます。通知は届きません。送信前に住所を必ずご確認ください。 よくある質問 住所を日本語で書いてもよいですか？ いいえ。カナダ郵政の機械は日本語を読み取れません。宛名はローマ字で書いてください。 カナダの郵便番号はどのような形式ですか？ 英字と数字が交互に並ぶ6文字で、間に半角スペースが入ります：A1A 1A1。日本のような数字7桁ではありません。 追跡はできますか？ 通常の普通郵便に追跡はありません。配達の証明が必要な場合は書留（Registered Mail）が必要で、これはカナダの郵便局の窓口からしか差し出せません。 カナダへ手紙を送る 手紙を書くかアップロードし、カナダの住所を入力してください。カナダで印刷し、カナダ郵政で投函します。3.49カナダドルから、印刷・税込。 手紙を送る 他の言語 India (Hindi) India (Punjabi) Philippines China (Simplified Chinese) Hong Kong / Taiwan (Traditional Chinese) Mexico, Latin America, Spain

text: Brief nach Kanada senden: so geht's (2026) Es gibt zwei Wege, einen Brief nach Kanada zu schicken: als internationale Sendung über die Deutsche Post, oder über einen Dienst, der den Brief direkt in Kanada druckt und als Inlandspost aufgibt. In beiden Fällen ist der häufigste Fehler derselbe — die Adresse. So schreibt man eine kanadische Adresse Zwei Gewohnheiten stehen im Weg. Erstens steht die Postleitzahl im deutschsprachigen Raum vor dem Ort („10115 Berlin”), in Kanada dagegen ganz am Ende der Zeile, nach der Provinz. title: ભારતથી કેનેડા પત્ર કેવી રીતે મોકલવો (2026) | sendletter
description: કેનેડાનું સરનામું યોગ્ય રીતે લખવાની રીત, પોસ્ટલ કોડનું બંધારણ, અને પત્ર ન પહોંચે તો શું થાય છે.
text: ભારતથી કેનેડા પત્ર કેવી રીતે મોકલવો (2026) ભારતથી કેનેડા પત્ર મોકલવાના બે રસ્તા છે: ભારતીય ટપાલ મારફતે આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય ટપાલ, અથવા એવી સેવા જે કેનેડામાં જ પત્ર છાપીને સ્થાનિક ટપાલ તરીકે મોકલે. બંનેમાં સૌથી મોટી ભૂલ એક જ છે — સરનામું. કેનેડાનું સરનામું કેવી રીતે લખવું ભારતમાં પિન કોડ છ આંકડાનો હોય છે. કેનેડાનો પોસ્ટલ કોડ અક્ષર અને આંકડા ભેગા કરીને બને છે — જેમ કે M5H 2N2. કેનેડા પોસ્ટ સૌથી પહેલાં આ જ વાંચે છે, એટલે ખોટો કે ગેરહાજર પોસ્ટલ કોડ સૌથી મોટી સમસ્યા છે. ભારતીય રીત શ્રી મહેશ પટેલ બ્લોક 7, શાંતિ એપાર્ટમેન્ટ સી.જી. રોડ, નવરંગપુરા અમદાવાદ, ગુજરાત 380009 ભારત કેનેડિયન રીત MAHESH PATEL 7-1450 DUNDAS ST W MISSISSAUGA ON L5C 1E4 CANADA ભારતીય સરનામાને કેનેડિયન રીતમાં બદલવું યુનિટ કે એપાર્ટમેન્ટ નંબર પહેલાં, ડેશ સાથે — 7-1450. શહેર, બે અક્ષરનો પ્રાંત કોડ અને પોસ્ટલ કોડ એક જ લીટીમાં. પ્રાંતનું આખું નામ નહીં: Ontario નહીં, ON. છેલ્લી લીટીમાં ફક્ત CANADA. આખું સરનામું રોમન લિપિમાં લખો. લિપિ સરનામું રોમન લિપિમાં જ હોવું જોઈએ. પત્રની અંદર તમે ગુજરાતીમાં લખી શકો છો, પણ કવર પરનું સરનામું ગુજરાતી લિપિમાં હોય તો કેનેડાનાં છટણી યંત્રો તે વાંચી શકશે નહીં. કેટલો સમય લાગે છે ભારતીય ટપાલ મારફતે આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય પત્ર સામાન્ય રીતે બે થી ચાર અઠવાડિયાં લે છે. કેનેડાની અંદરથી મોકલેલો પત્ર કેનેડા પોસ્ટ મુજબ ત્રણ થી સાત કામકાજી દિવસ લે છે. કેનેડામાં ગુજરાતી સમુદાય મુખ્યત્વે ટોરોન્ટો વિસ્તાર (મિસિસાગા, બ્રેમ્પટન, એટોબિકોક) અને એડમન્ટનમાં વસેલો છે. આ વિસ્તારોનાં સરનામાંમાં ઘણી વાર યુનિટ નંબર હોય છે — તે છોડી દેવાથી પત્ર ખોવાય છે. જો પત્ર ન પહોંચે આ ધ્યાનથી વાંચો: અમે તમારા વતી પત્ર મોકલીએ ત્યારે તે કેનેડામાં છપાય છે અને સ્થાનિક ટપાલ તરીકે જાય છે, જ્યારે પરત સરનામું ભારતનું હોય છે. જો કેનેડિયન સરનામું ખોટું હોય, તો પત્ર ભારત પાછો મોકલી શકાતો નથી — આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય પરત ટપાલ ખર્ચ ચૂકવાયો જ નથી. કેનેડા પોસ્ટના પોતાના નિયમો પ્રમાણે આવી ટપાલ ખોલવામાં આવે છે અને જો તેની કોઈ સ્પષ્ટ કિંમત ન હોય તો નાશ કરવામાં આવે છે. તમને કોઈ સૂચના મળશે નહીં. વારંવાર પુછાતા પ્રશ્નો શું સરનામું ગુજરાતીમાં લખી શકાય? ના. કેનેડા પોસ્ટનાં યંત્રો ગુજરાતી લિપિ વાંચતાં નથી. સરનામું રોમન લિપિમાં હોવું જોઈએ. કેનેડાનો પોસ્ટલ કોડ કેવો દેખાય છે? છ અક્ષર, અક્ષર અને આંકડા વારાફરતી, વચ્ચે એક જગ્યા: A1A 1A1. તે ફરજિયાત છે. શું પત્રનું ટ્રેકિંગ મળે છે? title: ወደ ካናዳ ደብዳቤ እንዴት መላክ ይቻላል (2026) | sendletter
description: የካናዳ አድራሻን በትክክል የመጻፍ መንገድ፣ የፖስታ ኮድ አጻጻፍ፣ እና ደብዳቤው ካልደረሰ ምን እንደሚሆን።
text: ወደ ካናዳ ደብዳቤ እንዴት መላክ ይቻላል (2026) ወደ ካናዳ ደብዳቤ ለመላክ ሁለት መንገዶች አሉ፦ በኢትዮጵያ ፖስታ በኩል ዓለም አቀፍ ፖስታ መላክ፣ ወይም ደብዳቤውን በካናዳ ውስጥ አትሞ እንደ የአገር ውስጥ ፖስታ የሚልክ አገልግሎት መጠቀም። በሁለቱም ውስጥ በጣም የተለመደው ስህተት አንድ ነው — አድራሻው። የካናዳ አድራሻ እንዴት እንደሚጻፍ በኢትዮጵያ አድራሻ ብዙውን ጊዜ የፖስታ ሳጥን ቁጥር እና ክፍለ ከተማ ይይዛል፣ የፖስታ ኮድ ግን አይጠቀምም። በካናዳ ግን የፖስታ ኮድ ግዴታ ነው፦ ፊደልና ቁጥር እየተቀያየሩ ስድስት ቁምፊ — ለምሳሌ M5H 2N2። ካናዳ ፖስት በመጀመሪያ የሚያነበው ይህንኑ መስመር ነው። ደግሞም በካናዳ የቤት ቁጥር ከመንገዱ ስም በፊት ይጻፋል። የኢትዮጵያ አጻጻፍ አቶ አበበ በቀለ ቦሌ ክፍለ ከተማ፣ ወረዳ 03 ፖ.ሳ.ቁ. 1234 አዲስ አበባ ኢትዮጵያ የካናዳ አጻጻፍ ABEBE BEKELE 12-1450 JANE ST TORONTO ON M9N 2R9 CANADA የኢትዮጵያ አድራሻን ወደ የካናዳ አጻጻፍ መቀየር የክፍለ ከተማና የወረዳ መስመሮችን ያስወግዱ — በካናዳ ተመሳሳይ ነገር የለም። የአፓርታማ ቁጥር ከሕንፃ ቁጥር በፊት፣ በሰረዝ ተያይዞ — 12-1450። የቤት ቁጥር ከመንገዱ ስም በፊት ይምጣ። ከተማ፣ የሁለት ፊደል የክፍለ ሀገር ኮድ እና የፖስታ ኮድ በአንድ መስመር ላይ። አድራሻውን በሙሉ በላቲን ፊደል ይጻፉ። ፊደል አድራሻው በላቲን ፊደል መጻፍ አለበት። የካናዳ ፖስት መደርደሪያ ማሽኖች የግዕዝ ፊደልን አያነቡም። የደብዳቤው ውስጠኛ ጽሑፍ በአማርኛ ሊሆን ይችላል፤ ገደቡ የሚመለከተው ፖስታው ላይ ያለውን አድራሻ ብቻ ነው። ምን ያህል ጊዜ ይወስዳል ዓለም አቀፍ ፖስታ ብዙውን ጊዜ ከሁለት እስከ አራት ሳምንት ይወስዳል። ከካናዳ ውስጥ የተላከ ደብዳቤ በካናዳ ፖስት መሠረት ከሦስት እስከ ሰባት የሥራ ቀናት ይወስዳል። በካናዳ ያለው የኢትዮጵያ ማኅበረሰብ በዋናነት በቶሮንቶ (በተለይ በዌስተን እና ላውረንስ ሃይትስ አካባቢ)፣ በኦታዋ፣ በካልጋሪ እና በኤድመንተን ይገኛል። በእነዚህ አካባቢዎች አድራሻዎች ብዙውን ጊዜ የክፍል ቁጥር አላቸው። ደብዳቤው ካልደረሰ ይህ በጣም አስፈላጊ ነው፦ በእርስዎ ስም ደብዳቤ ስንልክ፣ ደብዳቤው በካናዳ ታትሞ እንደ የካናዳ የአገር ውስጥ ፖስታ ይላካል፤ የመመለሻ አድራሻው ግን በኢትዮጵያ ነው። የካናዳው አድራሻ ስህተት ከሆነ ደብዳቤው ሊመለስ አይችልም — ዓለም አቀፍ የመመለሻ ክፍያ ተከፍሎ አያውቅምና። በካናዳ ፖስት ደንብ መሠረት እንዲህ ያለው ፖስታ ተከፍቶ ግልጽ ዋጋ ከሌለው ይወገዳል። ምንም ማሳወቂያ አይደርስዎትም። ተደጋጋሚ ጥያቄዎች አድራሻውን በአማርኛ መጻፍ እችላለሁ? አይቻልም። የካናዳ ፖስት ማሽኖች የግዕዝ ፊደልን አያነቡም። አድራሻው በላቲን ፊደል መሆን አለበት። የካናዳ ፖስታ ኮድ ምን ይመስላል? ስድስት ቁምፊ፣ ፊደልና ቁጥር እየተቀያየሩ፣ በመካከል አንድ ክፍተት፦ A1A 1A1። ግዴታ ነው። ደብዳቤው ክትትል አለው? ተራ የደብዳቤ ፖስታ ክትትል የለውም። የመድረስ ማረጋገጫ ከፈለጉ የተመዘገበ ፖስታ ያስፈልጋል፤ ይህም ከካናዳ ፖስታ ቤት ብቻ ይላካል። ወደ ካናዳ ደብዳቤ ይላኩ ደብዳቤዎን ይጻፉ ወይም ይስቀሉ፣ የካናዳ አድራሻ ያስገቡ — በካናዳ አትመን በካናዳ ፖስት እንልካለን። ከ3.49 CAD ጀምሮ፣ ኅትመትና ግብር ተካትቷል። ደብዳቤ ላክ This page was translated without a native reviewer. title: How to Mail a Letter to Canada From Nigeria (2026) | sendletter
description: Canadian addresses require a postal code and a two-letter province — two fields Nigerian senders rarely write. Here is the format, and what happens if it goes wrong.
text: How to Mail a Letter to Canada From Nigeria (2026) Two options: international post through NIPOST, or a service that prints your letter inside Canada and mails it domestically. The failure mode is the same either way, and it is not the one most senders expect — it is the postal code. How to write a Canadian address Nigerian addresses work perfectly well without a postcode. NIPOST issues six-digit codes, but almost nobody writes them, and delivery does not depend on them. Canada is the opposite: the postal code is the first thing the sorting machine reads, and an address without one is handled by exception — slowly, if at all. The province abbreviation is the second field you will not be used to writing. Nigerian format Mr. Chinedu Okafor 15 Awolowo Road, Ikoyi Lagos Nigeria Canadian format CHINEDU OKAFOR 22-140 ERIN MILLS PKWY MISSISSAUGA ON L5A 3P2 CANADA Converting a Nigerian address to Canadian format Find the postal code before you send. It is mandatory and it is the field that actually routes the letter. Put the unit or apartment number before the building number with a hyphen — 22-140. City, two-letter province code and postal code all go on one line. Never spell the province out: ON, not Ontario. AB, not Alberta. Last line is CANADA, on its own, in capitals. How long it takes International post from Nigeria typically takes two to four weeks, sometimes longer. A letter posted inside Canada takes three to seven business days according to Canada Post. Nigerian communities in Canada are concentrated in the Greater Toronto Area (Brampton, Mississauga, Scarborough), Calgary, Edmonton and Winnipeg. Apartment living is common in these areas, so the unit number is usually part of the address — leaving it off is a frequent cause of non-delivery. If the letter can't be delivered This matters more here than most places: when we send on your behalf, the letter is printed in Canada and posted as Canadian domestic mail, while the return address is in Nigeria. If the Canadian address is wrong, the letter cannot be returned to you — international return postage was never paid. Under Canada Post's own rules such mail is opened and destroyed if it has no obvious value. You will get no notification. Since the postal code is the field most likely to be missing or guessed, confirm it with the recipient before sending. Frequently asked questions What if I don't know the postal code? Ask the recipient. Do not guess — a wrong postal code routes the letter to the wrong sorting area, and unlike a missing house number there is no human who can correct it. What does a Canadian postal code look like? Six characters alternating letter and number, with a space in the middle: A1A 1A1. It is not six digits like a NIPOST code. Is the letter tracked? Ordinary lettermail has no tracking. If you need proof of delivery you need Registered Mail, which can only be lodged at a post office counter in Canada.
